subject: SprintGate demo availability — request to shift due to budget sprint

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SprintGate demo availability — request to shift due to budget sprint

Hi James —

Thanks again for taking the time to explore Redwood with us. We have a 60-minute slot penciled for the product demo on Tuesday, Dec 7 at 10:00am PT. Before I lock the invite I wanted to flag a short brief that may make that timing awkward: your finance team mentioned a short internal sprint (SprintGate) focused on the FY reset that week. If that sprint pulls the CFO/finance approver into critical planning meetings, we should rebook while stakeholders are available.

Quick ask: are you expecting any spend-freeze/committee sessions around Dec 6–9 that would make the 7th risky? If so, we can propose two alternate windows (Dec 14–16 mornings PT, or Dec 21–22 quick 45min slots) — happy to be flexible.

I've attached a short one-pager that frames the demo outcomes for procurement and a calendar screenshot with tentative alternatives.

Attachment: sprint-gate-brief.pdf (application/pdf, 240 KB)
Attachment: calendar-screenshot.png (image/png, 85 KB)

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132

Irene —

Appreciate the heads up. Confirming: the CFO has a planning offsite Dec 6–8 and procurement has a freeze window we call SprintGate that could overlap with your current slot on Dec 7. My ask is to avoid the week of Dec 6 if possible — our approvers will be triaged into planning sessions and won't be available for a demo that needs procurement and finance present.

Can you do Dec 15 (anytime PT) or Dec 21 (afternoon PT)? If you can do the 15th that would be ideal — procurement is doing a short review that afternoon but they said morning slots are safer.

James Long
VP, IT Transformation | SynergyWorks
james.long@synergyworks.com
